settings.heading: I'm the one you message when it goes wrong
settings.text:
I started two years ago from my bedroom with one supplier and about £40. I've made every mistake this business has to offer — wrong agent, wrong product, stock stuck in customs for six weeks — which is why I'm useful when it happens to you.

I'd rather have 22 people in the private chat who are actually scaling than 500 who bought a list and gave up. That's the whole point of the group.

settings.question: What if I join and it's not for me?
settings.answer: You get 15 minutes inside the group chat to look around and decide. If you want out, say so and you get a full refund — no argument, no questions.

settings.question: Why is it £174.99?
settings.answer:
Because of what it's worth, not what it costs me to send. The supplier list alone would run to about £1,500 bought individually, and members have made multiples of the entry price back from what's in here.

It's one payment, it never expires, and you get 15 minutes inside to decide it's not for you and take a full refund. If it doesn't pay for itself you shouldn't be paying for it.

settings.question: How are you different from every other plug?
settings.answer: Two things. I've ordered from everything I sell, so I can tell you what the quality and the shipping are actually like rather than repeating a claim. And you can message me afterwards — most of them sell you a list and go quiet, which is why people buy one and never scale.

settings.question: Is the free group actually free?
settings.answer: Yes. No card, no email, no trial that runs out. You join, you read, you ask, and if you never buy anything that's completely fine. The paid community exists for people who want the full vault — it isn't a wall in front of the free chat.

settings.question: How do I know this isn't a scam?
settings.answer: Fair question, and you shouldn't take my word for it. The vouches channel is public and open before you spend anything — every screenshot in it is from a real member. Join the free group first and watch it for a week. Nothing about that costs you money.

settings.question: What does buying a supplier actually get me?
settings.answer: The supplier's contact details and their full catalogue, so you can browse everything they make and order directly. It's digital — it lands the moment you pay, and you get an email link as well.

settings.question: Which supplier should I start with?
settings.answer: Depends on the niche you want to run. They've all been ordered from and checked personally, so it isn't a question of which ones are real — it's which products you want to sell. Ask in the free group and I'll point you at the right one.

settings.question: Do they ship to the UK?
settings.answer: Yes, worldwide, using an agent. The full agent walkthrough is included free with anything you buy, and the basics get posted in the free group too.

settings.question: I've never resold anything before. Is this for me?
settings.answer: Yes — that's most of the group. Start in the free chat, follow the guide, place one small test order through an agent. You don't need stock, a company, or money up front to learn how it works.
